text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the start of Curren Chan's second summer camp, and it's time to prepare for the biggest race of her career—the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she's coming off of a very busy schedule, I ask how she's doing. In response, she coyly says that she got through it due to my love for her.
